dedupe_keys.name: mars express power challenge raw telemetry

description: The European Space Agency (ESA) publishes Mars Express Power Challenge telemetry for predicting thermal-system electric current. The training set spans three Martian years from August 2008 to April 2014; a fourth-year test set through March 2016 provides context without the target observations. Context CSVs describe solar angles, operation commands, pointing, events and daily orbital quantities. Training observations contain 33 thermal-power current channels, usually sampled every 30 or 60 seconds, with hourly averages as the prediction target. A ZIP archive is freely available on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. These measurements can calibrate spacecraft energy simulations alongside orbital calculations with model-orekit. A caveat is that communications introduce gaps and many command strings act as signatures, not fully explained physical actions. Current measurements are not power values without the relevant electrical conversion. The later processed Figshare collection is a distinct representation. No archive was downloaded.
